sample_text: Every line in this film is spoken by someone like me. The square was quiet when he finally arrived, and nobody knew what would happen next.

voices.narrator: Narrator, deep smooth baritone, measured pace, documentary authority with a hint of dry humor.
voices.caster: Esports commentator, energetic and fast, excited, rising intensity, punchy delivery.
voices.storyteller: Warm storyteller, gentle mid-pitched voice, unhurried, like reading a bedtime adventure.
voices.deadpan: Dry deadpan announcer, flat and unimpressed, slow, understated sarcasm.
voices.trailer: Movie trailer voice, very deep, gravelly, dramatic pauses, epic.
voices.adult_male: Adult man in his thirties, warm medium-low voice, clear and natural, relaxed everyday delivery.
voices.adult_female: Adult woman in her thirties, clear bright voice, natural and confident, everyday delivery.
voices.young_male: Young man around twenty, casual, quick, a little cocky, light voice.
voices.young_female: Young woman around twenty, lively, expressive, quick and friendly.
voices.kid: Child around ten years old, high light voice, energetic and curious, a little breathless.
voices.teen: Teenage boy, voice not quite settled, eager, talks fast.
voices.elderly_male: Old man in his seventies, slow, gravelly, slightly hoarse, thoughtful pauses.
voices.elderly_female: Old woman in her seventies, soft, slightly shaky, kind and unhurried.
voices.gruff: Big gruff man, deep gravelly growl, menacing and blunt, villain energy.
voices.villain: Smooth villain, low silky voice, calm and threatening, enjoys every word.
voices.hero: Earnest hero, strong clear voice, determined, slightly breathless from running.
voices.coward: Nervous man, high tight voice, stammers slightly, always about to run.
voices.merchant: Fast-talking merchant, brisk, slightly nasal, persuasive and impatient.
voices.warrior_woman: Tough woman, low steady voice, commanding, few words.
voices.wise: Calm wise mentor, low gentle voice, slow and certain.
voices.goofy: Goofy comic sidekick, bouncy, cracks up at his own jokes, exaggerated.
voices.whisper: Soft whispering voice, secretive, close to the microphone.
voices.robot: Flat synthetic voice, even pitch, clipped and precise.
voices.crowd: Average adult, neutral voice used as one layer of a crowd.
